gaps.sentence: He answered all the questions with great ___ (CONFIDENT).
gaps.explanation: 'Great' needs a noun: confidence. 'Confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: We had no ___ (CHOOSE) but to cancel the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Have no choice but to do something' is the fixed phrase; the noun of 'choose' is an irregular 'choice'.

gaps.hint: person needed: someone who installs wiring
gaps.explanation: An electrician is the person who works with electricity; 'electric' and 'electrical' are adjectives.

gaps.sentence: She was fired for ___ behaviour at work (PROFESSIONAL).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed before the noun 'behaviour'
gaps.explanation: The prefix un- forms the negative adjective: unprofessional behaviour is behaviour below professional standards.
The noun of 'wise' is 'wisdom' (-dom suffix); 'wisedom' is a common misspelling.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is still unknown.
The editor-in-chief oversees every ___ (EDIT) of the magazine.
gaps.explanation: "Every edition" = every published issue; "editor" is the person.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (SURVIVE) of the species is under threat.
gaps.explanation: The noun from SURVIVE is 'survival'; a survivor is a person.
